reachabilityDisplay.title: Safe bikeable distance
reachabilityDisplay.subtitle: Roads are colored by how much of Seattle is within a safe biking distance.
reachabilityDisplay.helpText: This page calculates how much of Seattle is reachable by bike without traveling on high-risk roads. Every road segment is assigned a risk score and the simulation determines how far you can travel from every starting point in Seattle on low-risk routes. To assign risk we assumed that separated paths, protected bike lanes, and Stay Healthy Streets are 'all-ages all-abilities' facilities. Greenways and unprotected bike lanes are moderate risk; unprotected bike lanes on arterials receive a higher risk score. Local streets and sharrows are higher risk, and arterials without a bike lane or highways are treated as high risk. The simulation accumulates risk, since even traveling on relatively low-risk roads your chance of a crash increases with distance.
